## Standards / Policy / Guideline Change Proposal

**Branch:** `std/<short-name>` (e.g.,
`std/cpp-style-update`)

**Compare URL:**
```
https://github.com/QSSLibrary/Team/compare/std/<short-name>?template=standards-policy.md
```

## Type of change

- [ ] **New document** (file doesn't exist yet)
- [ ] **Major revision** (substantive changes to
      existing text)
- [ ] **Minor revision** (clarifications,
      examples, typo fixes)

## Summary

[What this PR changes]

## Motivation

[Why this change is needed]

## Impact assessment

- **Which contributors are affected?**
- **Which existing PRs / behavior would need to
  change?**
- **Is this a breaking change to existing
  practice?** (e.g., a new required signature,
  a new mandatory CI check)
- **What is the migration path if it is
  breaking?**

## Authority

Per `governance/evolution.md` §6.1, standards and
policies are amended by the project lead (Phase 1)
or TSC (Phase 2+). Guidelines are advisory and
require the same authority.

## Process checklist

- [ ] I followed `templates/proposal.md` (for
      major changes)
- [ ] I have run a 7-day public comment period
- [ ] I have updated the affected document's
      decision log
- [ ] I have considered whether tooling needs to
      be updated (clang-format config, CI rules,
      etc.)
